confidence_notes: Local [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Varanasi) data are sparse and partly postdate July 2026. Cocktail and wine estimates use beer price relationships and limited [local bar data](https://ttdi.net/in/varanasi/nightlife/). Accommodation is a holistic estimate and may vary with festival demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on lower-cost North Indian cities, adjusted for Varanasi's pilgrimage tourism and July monsoon season.
